title: Project: Laminar plugin schema
description: The schema required for plugins of Project: Laminar plugins

id.title: The unique identifier of the plugin
id.description: The version number will be appended to this to make the package file name

major-version.title: The major version number
major-version.description: Typically incremented for significant changes, and always incremented for breaking changes. Semantic versioning is recommended for Project: Laminar plugins

patch-version.title: The patch version
patch-version.description: This is typically automatically incremented, but you can opt-in to manual patch version support

prerelease-version.title: The prerelease version, used to indicate an unstable release

user-friendly-name.title: The name of the plugin shown to the user

description.title: A user-friendly description of the plugin

plugin-dependencies.title: List of plugins that this plugin depends on

output-path.title: The destination path that the built plugin will be output to
